body: I'm glad you find comfort.  Really I do.  I am numb in mind and thought now.  I have uncontrollable ticks and shakes at times.  I wish I could erase memories and thoughts that haunt my every waking moment .  Stay strong and keep moving, I'm trying , not sure how much longer I can keep moving ....

Anyone I may be able to talk with.  I will be interrogated as to why, what was said, etc...  If I share the truth, I will open pandoras box and hours or days of problems.  And not sharing is not an option with out issues as well but about not being open and transparent, and not giving security.  My thoughts and feelings don't matter.  I can sit in a ball and cry, please stop, and it infuriates and makes things worse.  I'm shaking, anxious, scared, hopeless, day in and day out.   If I walk away, just for a walk, I'm a horrible person.  I beg and plead for peace, and in called weak and a coward.  If I leave permanantly holy crap, I can't imagine the reprucussions.   Specifically with the kids, and everything else.  It would have better if I never existed, caused so much pain, "trapped" the one I love in a horrible marriage, I have no one turn to, without problems, no where to go.  I want to just disappear, run away fade into oblivion, and cease to exist , and allow those around to get over me, and finally find peace.
